achievements.name: Emperor
achievements.description: Win the game by becoming the Emperor of Norland.

achievements.name: Head of State
achievements.description: Create your own kingdom or City Alliance.

achievements.name: Horde Hammer
achievements.description: Defeat the Unholy Horde.

achievements.name: Big City
achievements.description: Reach a population of 100 people.

achievements.name: Trader
achievements.description: Earn 500 gold in a day from trade contracts.

achievements.name: Long-liver
achievements.description: Survive for 50 days.

achievements.name: Winner
achievements.description: Win 10 battles.

achievements.name: Commonwealth of Cultures
achievements.description: Your noble family must have lords of all 4 cultures.

achievements.name: RUTABAGA!
achievements.description: Collect 1000 Rutabagas.

achievements.name: Dead Bishop
achievements.description: Kill a bishop, for God's sake!

achievements.name: Unlucky Hunter
achievements.description: The king died while hunting.

achievements.name: Nectar Paradise
achievements.description: Starting from day 20, all your peasants in the city are nectar addicts.

achievements.name: Long Live the King
achievements.description: Starting from day 20, all your peasants in the city are loyalists.

achievements.name: In the Name of Sophia
achievements.description: Starting from day 20, all your peasants in the city are fanatics.

achievements.name: Lone Hero
achievements.description: Destroy a forest bandit camp with a single king.

achievements.name: Blind Fury
achievements.description: A blind lord must win a duel.

achievements.name: Great Lord
achievements.description: A lord must reach level 20 in three skills.

achievements.name: Family of Bastards
achievements.description: Starting from day 20, all lords must be bastards.

achievements.name: Survivor with Scars
achievements.description: Survive a smallpox epidemic.

achievements.name: Cruel Tyrant
achievements.description: Execute 25 innocent characters.

achievements.name: Henry VIII
achievements.description: The king must marry 6 wives and kill 2 of them.

achievements.name: Lone Genius
achievements.description: Become an emperor while playing only as one king.

achievements.name: Great Scholar
achievements.description: A lord must read 10 level 3 books.

achievements.name: Big Library
achievements.description: Collect 50 different books.

achievements.name: Wolf Hammer
achievements.description: Survive a wolf pack attack.
